description: An item's observed unit-price range (min, median, max per kg, L or item) by flyer week (Thursday to Wednesday), from flyer offers and shelf prices near a place, plus `longRun`: the Statistics Canada monthly average unit price for the item since 2017 (Ontario, else Canada), with its 1- and 5-year change. `weeksKnown` says how many weeks Gaurmon has: its history started with the Oct 29 2026 flyer week and grows by one each Thursday, so say so when it's short, and say `longRun` is a provincial average, not a store price.

item.description: The generic item, as compare_items takes it: "chicken thighs", "large eggs", "bananas". Not a brand or receipt code.

near.description: Where the shopper is: a Canadian postal code ("M6H 2B6"), an FSA ("M6H"), or "lat,lng".

unit.description: Compare in this unit (default: the one most prices use).

weeks.description: How many flyer weeks back, including this one (default 8).

name: price_history
title: Price history for an item
